reply:
Hi Sofia,

1. I built an article-tagging service that assigns topics and named entities to every new article with an LLM; it tags about 600 articles a day for the editorial team. I owned the prompts and the API.
2. Editors corrected tags on 300 articles, and we use them as a test set; tag precision went from 0.70 to 0.88.
3. Breaking news with names the model has never seen; we add a lookup against our people database.
4. Dates and article IDs are handled in code; the model only proposes tags.
5. My rate is $31 per hour.

Best,
Elena
